senses.gloss: m. pl. (זכי, Pa.) clearings, i.e. twigs, roots &c. collected for clearing the ground, rubbish.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 10b:7">M. Kat. 10ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 54a:3">B. Bath. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>האי מאן דזכי ז׳</he> (Ar. <cite ref="G00458"><he>זִכַּיָּא</he></cite>, Var. in Mss. &c. <he>דִּיכַּיָּא</he>, <he>דִּכַּ׳</he>, <cite ref="G00455"><he>זִכַּ׳</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he who clears away rubbish.
